entries.text: `make sql-execution-gate` fails closed on vacuous comparisons: a query whose result has no rows, or only NULL or 0 cells, on both the engine and DuckDB is a `vacuous` finding unless gate-only augmented data (a second warehouse for TPC-DS Q16, Q94 and Q95) proves it or a reasoned `vacuous` entry in `expected_differences.json` allows it. The report lists the vacuous queries per benchmark and engine as not proven. `make tpcds-obt-equivalence` uses the same definition and records Q16, Q94 and Q95 among its unverifiable queries.
